## What the game uses

The bone hand only, unedited. The werewolf, witch and zombie hands and every "wait" frame were left out.

| File | Size (px) | Use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `bone_hand_1_default.png` | 64 x 64 | cursor over the page (fine pointers only) |
| `bone_hand_2_hover.png` | 64 x 64 | cursor over an enabled button (green ectoplasm outline) |
| `bone_hand_3_click.png` | 64 x 64 | cursor while a button is pressed |

The art is drawn at 64 x 64 (not an upscale). Show it at 32 x 32 CSS px with `image-set(... 2x)`, which is pixel exact on 2x screens. The hotspot is (5, 5) in the 64 px image, so (2, 2) in CSS pixels. This is optional polish; see the Cursor section of `.kiro/steering/ui-style.md`.
